description: Is this address a wallet or a contract? Nonce and native balance per chain. For one address on one or all EVM chains (Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, BSC, Polygon, Optimism, Avalanche): wallet vs contract vs EIP-7702 delegated account, bytecode size, transaction count (nonce) and native balance. Use before sending funds or to sanity-check a counterparty. Cached 15 s. Price $0.001 per call (x402: USDC on Base or Solana).
